title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Hordern Pavilion, Sydney | 2013
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Hordern Pavilion in Sydney, Australia, on 13 February 2013.

It was the fourth show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s 2013 tour, which lasted for 28 dates between February and November, and the first of two consecutive nights in Sydney.

Wings had performed at the Hordern Pavilion on 7 and 8 November 1975.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, percussion
